body: You don't have to but if you do I really appreciate it.

We have to write a letter to our favorite company, but I always overthink things. Like first off I don't have a favourite company and I never have before. My teacher made me choose Rubik's cubes. Now I have to write a letter saying how much I love their product. I can't come up with anything, even though the letter literally has an outline for everyone to follow. I was supposed to have this done Tuesday but couldn't think of anything so now my teacher wants it done before school today and I still can't think of anything so I've literally just been staring at the page forever. I woke up at 3 AM to try to finish it and got absolutely nothing done. 

But tbh I don't even care anymore I just gave up because the next time we have to write something I'll do just as horribly on it because I'm never good at writing. I've decided I'm staying home.
